entries.048ff6f7f166b367: Thermal spraying performed by the company on a standalone basis. It forms coatings of metals, ceramics, cermets and similar materials on the surfaces of parts for semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment, parts for industrial machinery such as gas turbines for power generation and various bearings, and equipment parts such as steel rolls, paper-making rolls and chemical plant parts.
